notes: The Pulse designation records (catalogue/pulse_designations.json, mirrored from PyAutoPulse decisions.yaml kind: designation) are the source of class optimal/secondary. This file holds only what they do not: likelihood x hardware-class groups the human held provisional, and planning metadata kept from the retired catalogue/provisional_designations.json (autolens_profiling#497).

A held cell keeps its lifecycle report section 3.3 provisional label: records are class secondary with provisional_optimal / provisional_secondary in limitations and no decision_id; its planned cells carry the provisional class itself.
regime_only_suffixes: designated routes that run only in a non-standard regime (_dft below 10,000 visibilities, _streaming at n_vis >= 1e7) are never planned in the standard regime.
instrument_scoped_setups: a setup planned only on the named instruments for the named dataset types.

holds.decision: Human 2026-10-31 (AskUserQuestion, 'Hold, keep provisional'): does not separate at sma, jax_gpu_sparse_fp64_wtilde 3.46 vs jax_gpu_dense_fp64_nufft 3.37 calls/s/node (1.03x, inside the 9 % tolerance); alma and alma_high measured only W~ sparse.

instrument_scoped_setups.reason: The library forms the dense transformed mapping matrix in one nufft2d2 over every source column: for S ~ 1280 it is 20.5 GB at alma, 102 GB at alma_high and 512 GB at jvla, so the dense pixelized route cannot run above sma (interferometer decision matrix rule 2: meshes above sma run W~, never dense).

instrument_scoped_setups.ruling: D1, proposed 2026-10-28 for the human's review (autolens_profiling#475): 2b's R1(a) carried to the datacube
instrument_scoped_setups.reason: Every datacube channel is the instrument's interferometer dataset, and the dense route forms each channel's transformed mapping matrix as the interferometer does (one nufft2d2 over every source column: 20.5 GB at alma, 102 GB at alma_high for S ~ 1280), so the dense datacube route cannot run above sma either.

footnote: Mixed precision is `experimental` everywhere at day zero (the fp32 leg currently runs fp64: Mind bug draft). Compile cost is recorded where available but is not a class axis.
